This is a free and open-source MQTT client, with source code hosted on GitHub. If you are ever prompted to pay, please uninstall immediately.

1. How to add a topic?
In the "Add Topic" screen, enter the server URL (DFRobot's server is recommended for testing), fill in the username and password, and add the topic you want to monitor.

2. What does the port 1883 mean?
1883 is the default port for the MQTT protocol. You can change it according to the actual port your server uses.

3. What does the "Notifications" option do?
When enabled, you will continue to receive new message notifications even when the screen is off. It works best together with the "Heartbeat" feature.

4. What is the "Heartbeat" feature for?
When enabled, the app will periodically send keep-alive packets, which helps prevent the system from freezing background processes and improves message timeliness, but it may increase battery consumption.

5. Why am I not receiving messages even when the screen is on?
Please go to your phone's Settings, turn off power-saving modes, or select "Manual management" in the app's launch settings and allow "Background activity".

6. Why does the message icon show the Android logo?
This is a bug caused by system cache, please restart your phone to fix it.

7. Why can't I receive MQTT messages?
This app currently only supports receiving messages via TCP and SSL protocols. Support for WS and WSS protocols is planned for future releases.

8. Why can't I see the topic after adding it?
Please try setting your system font size to standard, or adjust the font size in the app.
